The '''Tondra clan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] extended family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. The clan moved to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] six [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The clan made their living by harvesting and procession [[Algae/Legends|algae]] from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] upper [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] using [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] with special [[airscoop]]s on the front. During the Galactic Civil War, the clan was led by [[Chando Tondra]].
